dedupe_keys.name: casting product image data for quality inspection

description: This dataset provides top-view images of cast submersible pump impellers for training a deep-learning model to identify defective products during manufacturing. The provider describes 7348 augmented grayscale images at 300 by 300 pixels, split into training and test folders with defective and acceptable labels. Training contains 3758 defective and 2875 acceptable images; testing contains 453 defective and 262 acceptable images. A separate unaugmented group contains 1300 images at 512 by 512 pixels, comprising 519 acceptable and 781 defective impellers. Coverage includes the augmented and unaugmented groups. Stable lighting was arranged for acquisition. The source acknowledges Pilot Technocast in Shapar, Rajkot, but does not explicitly locate every acquisition there or give collection dates. This supports pump-component quality classification; it does not provide hydraulic performance or remaining-life measurements. CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 terms are stated. Reuse charges and payload access restrictions are not established by the metadata. No images, archives or linked prototype video were obtained.
